// P-FLOW-22 / P-345 RED fixture for `flow-determinism` (contract 1.6 / index 9.2, architecture
// §4.9 item 6) — the lint MUST reject this. A CI-pipeline workflow BODY (`// @workflow-body`) that
// reads the wall clock, a real RNG, and sleeps via raw `std`/`tokio` calls INSTEAD of the
// deterministic `WfCtx` SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB surface. Each raw non-deterministic read makes replay
// diverge: a CI pipeline that branched on `SystemTime::now()` or dispatched a stage chosen by
// `rand::random()` would, on re-execution from the journal, dispatch a DIFFERENT stage or skip a
// build — the non-deterministic-replay bug class (a double-deploy / a lost run). The divergence
// guard (P-FLOW-07) halts such a run; this lint stops the body from compiling in the first place.
//
// NOT real crate code — it lives under `/fixtures/` (excluded from the live workspace lint-gate)
// and is scanner DATA for the committed-ratchet self-test (`tests/lint_fixtures.rs`). The GREEN
// fixture (`ci_pipeline.flow.green.rs.txt`) expresses the SAME pipeline through `run_ci_pipeline`
// (the deterministic SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB surface) and IS real code that compiles against `WfCtx`.
use std::time::SystemTime;

// @workflow-body — this fn is a durable CI-pipeline workflow body; the flow-determinism lint fires.
pub fn ci_pipeline_workflow(ctx: &mut WfCtx) {
    // RED: raw wall-clock read — replay would return a DIFFERENT instant (must go through ctx.now()).
    let started_at = SystemTime::now();
    // RED: a real RNG draw deciding which stage to dispatch — replay would pick a DIFFERENT stage
    // (the stage order/selection MUST be deterministic, derived from the journaled input).
    let _stage_pick = rand::random::<u64>() % 3;
    // RED: a raw timer sleep blocking a worker — a CI stage must PARK durably via the
    // SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB long-park (ctx.schedule_and_run_job), never block a worker for the build.
    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3600));
    // RED: a raw v4 UUID for a dispatch idem_token — the SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB idem_token MUST be
    // deterministic on the command position so the runner + the workflow agree without coordination.
    let _idem = Uuid::new_v4();
    let _ = (started_at, ctx);
}
